title: Dynamic Station Bursar network: 1 trader per policed Exchange station (live book refresh, bottleneck buy_order, surplus sell_order)
note: Policy-driven dynamic Bursar network governed by game/bursar-policy.json (Mercury/Unity). Each trader atomically claims 1 unstaffed Exchange station (preferring current dock and own empire), refreshes market & mission books at 0 fuel, posts wholesale buy_order walls for open needs.tsv bottlenecks, and liquidates unreserved surplus without self-undercutting.
